Analysis of Drug Interactions and Anticoagulation Intensity of Warfarin in Inpatients Based on the Drug Instructions
Xu Peng，Zhang Guozhu( Department of Pharmacy，the Third People ’ s Hospital of Hefei，Hefei 230022，China)ABSTRACT Objective: To provide reference for the role of clinical pharmacist played in the standardized use of warfarin in anticoagulation therapy． Methods: A retrospective analysis was conducted on the inpatients received warfarin． The information on the monitoring of INR and concomitant medications likely with drug interactions with warfarin were evaluated． Results: Totally 127 cases received one or more concomitant medications likely with drug interactions with warfarin，which accounted for 79． 9% ( 127 /159) ． Of the 23 concomitant medications，the frequency of traditional Chinese medicine injections was 32． 5% ( 95 /292) ，which included Danshen preparations，Ginseng preparations and Gingko preparations． INR was tested in 146 cases． Of the 80 cases whose INR was less than two，45 ones were with the stable dose of warfarin． Totally 36 cases ( 22% ) suspended warfarin during the hospitalization and 118 cases ( 74． 2% ) were ordered to take warfarin for a long time． Conclusion: The use of warfarin in anticoagulation therapy should be further regularized，especially that of low intensity of anticoagulation and concomitant medications with Chinese medicine injections should be intervened．KEY WORDS Warfarin; Concomitant medication; Drug interactions; Traditional Chinese medicine injections; Anticoagulation intensity华法林为使用最为广泛的口服抗凝药，华法林长期抗凝主要用于静脉血栓的预防和治疗、房颤以及心脏瓣膜置换术后。 华法林的治疗指数窄，再加上合并药物、食物、患者身体状况以及遗传等诸多因素均会影响华法林的抗凝作用，因此，华法林在长期抗凝治疗过程中较易发生出血不良反应。
